decision: Retain current core5; discard core6 and core10 variants

baseline.equivalence: Native tree b1493193450f86fbb7bc8d13aea8a5357436e1ad and root cargo config unchanged in main4a89; fresh baseline measurements made for each comparison

comparison.percentile_scope: Per-process region percentiles; small sample counts are descriptive, not production tail estimates

measurement.legacy_gpu_ms_scope: Legacy name for host terrain preparation, including CPU work; not device execution

measured_process_usage.clock_scope: Unix timestamps bracket the batch and CPU samples for observation alignment only; wall-clock adjustments may affect them. Latency uses the existing monotonic perf_counter interval. No per-request CPU attribution is implied.
measured_process_usage.scope: Process user/kernel deltas for the whole process and all its threads around the measured batch, including executor creation/join and host driver work. Excludes startup, warmups, readiness wait and later snapshot/hash/NBT validation work. GPU device execution and other processes are not CPU time here. Context-switch/fault counts are platform-reported observations, not wait durations. Average scheduled cores is CPU seconds divided by elapsed batch seconds, not worker occupancy or an elapsed-time share.

memory_peak_scope.generation_peak_rss_bytes: Process lifetime through measured generation, including startup and warmups; excludes later snapshot processing and output validation
memory_peak_scope.note: Unix RSS or Windows peak working set. High-water marks, not current memory or isolated phase allocations; neither field proves sustained memory stability
memory_peak_scope.peak_rss_bytes: Process lifetime through output hashing, optional NBT comparison and optional specialization regeneration; retained legacy field

counter_storage.bytes_scope: Counter backing only; excludes allocator overhead and candidate/terrain tracking.
counter_storage.snapshot_scope: Shards are read sequentially. Totals are exact modulo u64 after updates join; a live snapshot is not a single instant across concurrent writers.

performance_diagnostics.note: Measured-interval deltas. Unique keys are first seen during this interval, excluding warmup keys. Recursive/concurrent durations overlap.
performance_diagnostics.scope: profile lifetime; concurrent and recursive durations overlap
performance_diagnostics.terrain_tile_scope: Measured-interval generation counts, including repeated tiles and all GPU guards; coordinates and side are chunks

validation.scope: Screening only; no broader unit/hardware/custom-world retention qualification because no implementation retained

limitations: Two observations per build/setting; descriptive intervals, not production tail bounds
Changing game/VM/compiler/desktop host load; no unrelated processes stopped or machine settings changed
No owned builds overlap headline benchmarks
Theoretical all-nonconstant staging volume is not an observed runtime tile count
No causal cache-miss claim or universal cross-hardware slowdown claim
No GPU/backend default or release changes
next: O2 representative Nether query/dependency attribution; direct-sky locality remains an unimplemented O3 lead based on prior phase data
